text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Summit between Mubarak, Arafat and Netanyahu depends on end to Israeli sanctions and determining the bases of resumption of peace talks. Invitation for such a three-way meeting must be preceded by specific arrangements to persuade Palestinians of benefit of meeting in moving negotiations forward. Albright says Mubarak is a strategic partner in the peace process.
- Mubarak meets Sudanese opposition leaders Sadeq al-Mahdi and Mohammed Othman al-Mirghani.
- Eleven agreements to be reviewed by Egyptian-Lebanese committee today. Hariri affirms Lebanon's appreciation of Mubarak's efforts.
- Mubarak and Jordan's King Hussein discuss in telephone conversation ways to save peace process. Crown Prince Hassan in quick visit to Egypt today.
- Prime Miniser Ganzouri issues decree on funding cotton crops.
- President names new presidents for universities.
- Prime Minister discusses with head of international company ways to boost exports of textiles to reach $200 million.
- Electricity Ministry to choose in December best offer to set up first private sector power station.
- New system for determining bourse closing prices.
- Private sector and cooperatives allowed to market fertiliser.
- Interior Ministry complains to prosecutor general about al-Shaab newspaper.
- Kuwaiti company al-Kharafi to build B.O.T. airport at Marsa Alam.
